I need to instruct users effectively regarding the issue. I should say something like, “If you notice any slowness or unfamiliar prompts, please stop using the portal and report the issue to IT. I want to keep this concise and clear, ensuring it’s no more than five sentences.

I want to create four sentences for our update.
